profile.name: M. Taufiqul Huda
profile.headline: M.S. student in Electronic and Computer Engineering | Analog/Mixed-Signal IC Design
profile.summary: Master's student at National Taiwan University of Science and Technology (NTUST), specializing in analog and mixed-signal IC design. Research focuses on ultra-low-power time-domain SAR ADCs. Experience spans analog IC design, open-source and commercial EDA flows, verification, and tapeout-oriented projects.

education.institution: National Taiwan University of Science and Technology (NTUST)
education.research: 14-bit time-domain SAR ADC for ultra-low-power applications

education.thesis: Biomedical ADC design with a time-domain comparator (130 nm)

experience.role: Laboratory Member / Analog IC Design Researcher
highlights: Researching high-resolution, ultra-low-power time-domain SAR ADCs.
Working across analog/mixed-signal IC design and performance optimization.
Improved SAR ADC design target from 10-bit to 12-bit using differential input.
Reduced ADC power consumption by more than 30% through a time-domain comparator approach.
Design submitted for SkyWater 130 nm tapeout.

experience.organization: Microelectronics and Embedded Systems Laboratory, ITS
highlights: Assisted students with electrical circuits, digital systems, and electronics practicums.
Worked in the research and training division to organize training and research-competition programs.

experience.organization: National Taiwan University of Science and Technology
highlights: Designed a 12-bit time-domain ADC in 180 nm technology.
Learned Cadence and Synopsys IC design flows and APR techniques.

selected_projects.name: Field Programmable Mixed-Signal Array (FPMA)
highlights: Designed a 16 x 70 switch matrix for flexible routing of FETs, current mirrors, and OTAs.
Integrated a tinyFPGA with 4 CLBs on-die.
Led architecture, schematic, top-level layout, and DRC/LVS verification.
